an1.296:1.3: The first six of these meditation topics are detailed in [an6.10]().
an1.297-305:1.3: The three mindfulness topics of breathing, body, and death are detailed especially in [mn10](), [mn118](), and [mn119](). | The “recollection of peace” (_upasamānussati_) is found only here (and at [an1.494]()), and is not further explained in early texts. Visuddhimagga 8.245 refers it to the recollection of Nibbāna at [an4.34:3.1]() and the set of terms found in the Asaṅkhata Saṁyutta ([sn43.1]() ff.).
